Constructed by [[Yoshi Raph-Elan]], this '''lightsaber''' had a rare orange crystal. It was damaged when its wielder crash-landed on a barren planet. It was later repaired using wiring from a [[Goliath (droid)|Goliath droid]].<ref name="SWR 27" />
